article.story: ORLANDO, Fla. -- — Trevor Mullin and Riley Fox each scored 20 points as Yale beat Wright State 72-70 on Wednesday. Mullin and Fox each had five rebounds for the Bulldogs (5-4). Chadlyn Traylor led the Raiders (6-2) in scoring, finishing with 22 points. Andrea Holden added 12 points and nine rebounds for Wright State. Kellen Pickett also had 12 points, six rebounds, two steals and five blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
